covers: sib8-p512-aut3 (ic.pipeline, wwalk x=2.0,g=1,grow=2,tw=2,cj=1,seed=run,lazy=1,sib=8,pool=512,aut=3) against rho-cubic (rho.cubic, A = 6) in GAE, on the j0b7 sessions at p = 34, 37, 40 bits (five curves each) of this directory. Not covered: any bit-op (bitop/v1) ratio of the aut=3 arms (validator-report.json erratum N1).
curve_uid_note: curve_uid is null on every record and in the bench record (no registered curve UIDs). The 15 curves are identified by their ICV1 slugs in band-j0b7-*.json; none was invented here.

rho_reference.protocol: PROTOCOL.md (frozen at 709f978290): rho-cubic, ecbench rho.cubic, the walk on {+-zeta3^i(P)} (A = 6) of the j = 0 curve's order-3 automorphism, named as the matched rho
rho_reference.unit: S = GAE / sqrt(r) per run (ecbench.gae), mean over the 180 paired measured runs of one size. The band adds w GAE per unpriced native operation: cost.unpriced counts (rho-cubic canonicalisations_uncharged; aut3 aut_canonicalisations_uncharged and the factor-base and row counters) plus counted table_insert_attempts, sibling_second_points and sibling_lift_products.
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench sha256 a2338b69323813fedc51e30a0eae52eb7287e0825f127c25600e7cf5f6256fe5; both arms in the same session per size (same spec, workloads, targets and algorithm seeds)
rho_reference.gae_band_size: p = 40 bits (sessions/j0b7-40), the largest size; every size in gae_band_by_size
rho_reference.gae_band_reading: AGENTS.md 5a applied alike to both arms; canonicalisations priced on both (E1 fixed: aut_canonicalisations_uncharged in cost.unpriced on 1,260/1,260 aut3 records, canonicalisations_uncharged on 630/630 rho-cubic records). This is the committed band.rs default reading; the validator recomputed it independently.
rho_reference.order_note: Unresolved at every size: sib8-p512-aut3 / rho-cubic is 0.992 / 0.875 / 0.909 at w = 0 (below) and 1.356 / 1.200 / 1.248 at w = 0.1 and 3.000 / 2.663 / 2.776 at w = 1 (above). No ranking of the two arms is supported. Per curve: 10/15 unresolved, 5/15 rho-cubic lower at every weight, 0/15 sib8-p512-aut3 lower at every weight.
